classic.text: Contributors: Alex Rivera, Jordan Lee, Sam Patel, Casey Nguyen, Riley Chen
- rye bread from the Saturday stall
- two slightly soft pears
- a small jar of honey
- leftover mint in a jam jar
- the blue bowl we keep by the sink
The river path stayed muddy after the storm, so we took
the long way around the school and talked about the
porch light that has been blinking since August. Someone
had left a chair out and the seat was a dark oval of
rainwater. We stood there longer than we meant to, just
watching the maple drop one leaf at a time onto the wet
sidewalk.
Later the kitchen windows fogged while the beans
simmered and the radio kept losing the station. I wrote
this down so October would still have the smell of that pot and the sound of the back door that never
quite latches unless you lean on it.
One short note about the porch light and the extra pictures from the walk.
